Name: TEE TOOL<sup>®</sup>
Short description: The TeeTool(R) has been in development for over 5 years. It has quite a bit of patent work and design behind it. It has been developed to the point that we are currently producing it only as a 3D print product. Therefore, you won’t see much of this particular product in the market yet. We want additional consumer feedback. It has been designed to comfortably fit in the golfer’s pocket or attached to the MAX on the golf bag. Its magnetic end point, when in the pocket, can help retrieve that lost ball mark. It includes a STAINLESS STEEL divot repair tool bearing the name TeeTool, a special spring slot for the ball mark, and 3 slots for various size golf tees. It was designed to hold a number of popular golf tees in the market, but specifically a popular brand that offers multiple size golf tees. The TeeTool offers the golfer the “complete accessories package”!\n\n(Max Magnet is sold separately or as a part of Tee Tool Combo Kit)
Description: The TeeTool™ uses three Pride Professional Tee System golf Tees™.  These Tees are the enhanced design and increased stability golf Tees produced by Pride.  As noted on their packaging, these tees are aerodynamically designed for the longer drives.  For these reasons, we selected the Pride Tees for use with our patented TeeTool™ product.  The TeeTool™ holds all three golf tees so that you will always have the size tee that you need at the Tee Box!\nThese are the three Pride Performance Plastic Golf Tee ™ sizes: 3 ¼” & 2 ¾” & 1 ½” Tee Lengths.  These Tees are Trademarked Tees and products of Pride Golf Tee, Brentwood, TN and are not the property of this website.
Categories: All Products, All Products > SPECIAL ORDER 3D PRINTS

Name: TEE TOOL<sup>®</sup> SLIM
Short description: Over the years, you will occasionally hear complaints from some golfers who keep their golf tees and ball marks in their pockets. At some point they either poke their finger, eventually ruin their pants pocket, or sometimes can’t even find the ball mark deep within their pocket. The TeeTool(R) SLIM, was developed to be the solution to those concerns, but with one popular golf tee in mind! The single TeeKeeper(R) can handle most pocket golf tees, but the SLIM was designed for the larger thicker shaft tees and golf heads. It even has a patented inner portion to accept and snap-in the STEP TEE ridge of certain golf tees. With a magnet on its end, it can find the missing pocket ball mark, OR, it can attach to apparel or a golf bag using the MINI or the MAX! It currently is being produced as a 3D print product.
Description: The TeeTool™ SLIM was specifically designed to hold the popular MARTINI® GOLF TEE as a means to cover the point of the tee so that there are no pokes in the hand or pocket from the tip of the Tee.  This is an issue with most golf tees since most maintain a point for easier placement in the ground.  What is especially unique in our design is that the TeeTool™ SLIM will hold the standard 3 ¼” Martini® Golf Tee or, via a special inner snap ridge, the 3 ¼”  (Step-Up) Martini® Golf Tee as well.
